productName: Physio Reformer Master Instructor With Tower
title: Elina Pilates Reformer Fisio Master Instructor With Tower
overviewParagraph: The Reformer Fisio Master Instructor With Tower is a professional tower reformer built for physiotherapy Pilates and users with reduced mobility, featuring a taller bed height that gives therapists easier access for safer, more effective rehab work. Crafted from American maple wood, its adjustable pulley tower supports hundreds of exercises and precise progressions from beginner to advanced. An ultra-silent, high‑precision bearing carriage plus a retractable rope collection system and smooth loop handles keep movement quiet and controlled for focused sessions. It includes the box, jump board, and handles to deliver complete, versatile training and rehabilitation in one machine.
inclusions: Structure + carriage of the Master Instructor reformer
Essentials Kit with box, jumping board, and handles
1 set of hard foam padded handles
1 set of cotton hand and foot loops double loop
Reformer springs: 2 strong red, 2 medium green, and 2 light yellow
Tower springs: 2 light short (yellow), 2 medium short (green), 2 light long (yellow), and 2 medium long (green)
